CryptoMeta.title: CryptoMeta
CryptoMeta.description: End-to-end encryption PBKDF2 salt and AES-256-GCM passphrase verification box for a user vault. Immutable once created.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the vault owner.

checkIv.description: Base64-encoded 12-byte GCM initialization vector for passphrase check.

check.description: Base64-encoded AES-256-GCM verification ciphertext and authentication tag.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the vault passphrase metadata was initialized.

Device.title: Device
Device.description: Registered source device backing up encrypted calls, SMS messages, and manual clipboard snippets.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the device owner.

name.description: User-assigned display name of the device.

enabled.description: Bounded list (max 3) of enabled backup categories from ['call', 'sms', 'clip'].

lastSyncAt.description: Epoch milliseconds of the last confirmed batch upload (0 if never synced).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest configuration or sync update.

EncRecord.title: EncRecord
EncRecord.description: End-to-end encrypted backup record (AES-256-GCM with AAD bound to id|type|ts) identified by deterministic SHA-256 hash.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the record owner.

ts.description: Original event timestamp in epoch milliseconds.

data.description: Base64-encoded AES-256-GCM encrypted JSON payload + 16-byte authentication tag.

/users/{uid}/meta/{metaId}.description: Stores the immutable E2EE salt and passphrase verification box at /users/{uid}/meta/crypto.

/users/{uid}/devices/{deviceId}.description: Stores registered backup devices belonging exclusively to {uid}.

/users/{uid}/devices/{deviceId}/records/.description: Stores deterministic-ID encrypted backup records belonging to {deviceId} under {uid}.
